data.body: Full suite after the change reported 1 failed and 1 error, neither caused by the change. tests/unit/test_local_git_host.py errored because git commit returned -11, a segfault, during a thirteen minute run. tests/unit/test_import_rebar_tickets.py test_status_is_mapped_to_the_rebar_vocabulary expected P-2 closed and saw open. Running tests/unit alone gives 1417 passed with zero failures, and the import file alone gives 9 passed, so both surface only under full-suite load.
